datasets.caveat: Prospective controlled adaptation. Same-host warmed decoder mean time versus undamped canonical BP+OSD0, not campaign elapsed time. Joint damping/constant-or-paper scaling/offset search; alpha*max(0,min_abs-beta), old-V2C damping. Every tested control/cap retained. Training never pooled with fresh confirmation. Preserve full cap progression for previous damping and selected joint settings. Runtime tolerance10%, explicit saturation/search ceilings and over-budget starting points. Binary BP X-only; Q-BP joint depolarizing at1.5p_X, distinct channels. Timings are host/cohort dependent; report actual ratios, not assumed equality. No source-reproduction or global-optimality claim.
